cli.serve_help.host: Host address (default: 127.0.0.1). Loopback-only by policy: every non-loopback bind is refused. File serving is unclamped on loopback connections; reach this API remotely through an explicit tunnel or an SSH port-forward.
cli.serve_help.reload: Enable hot reload for the server
cli.serve_help.listener_fd: Adopt an already-bound listening socket instead of binding one. Set by a daemon replacing its own process image onto a new build (`server/reload`), so the port never has a moment with nothing behind it. Not a user-facing flag.
